conf.description: ArcSight Connectors agent.log/wrapper log, syslog-raw: bracketed 4-field prefix regex_extract with a message=_raw fallback for the undocumented wrapper-log prefix, stack-trace continuation capture (Event-Breaker assumption), best-effort exception-class extraction, before batched rename.

conf.comment: arcsight-connectors/agent-log/syslog-raw. ASSUMES the Source's Event Breaker starts a new event on a line beginning '[YYYY-MM-DD', so a bracketed line plus any untimestamped stack-trace continuation lines arrive as ONE multi-line _raw -- true reassembly is Source-level config, out of scope here (same treatment as windows-dns-dhcp's dns.log gap). log.file.path reads __path, the conventional Cribl File-source breadcrumb; no File Source exists on this instance to verify the name (assumption, not confirmed). The wrapper log's undocumented prefix will not match the bracket grammar; on a non-match this falls back to message=_raw per the recommendation, instead of leaving message empty. No connector-host timezone table exists here, so _time is naive local time (same gap category used elsewhere in this map).

functions.description: document grammar, multiline and file-path assumptions
Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.

extract the four bracketed prefix fields and the first line's message text; simply does not match the wrapper log's undocumented prefix or a bare continuation line, leaving all four groups undefined rather than erroring
capture every physical line after the first as the Java stack-trace continuation, when the Source's Event Breaker has grouped one onto this event

best-effort extraction of a fully-qualified Java exception/error class name out of the free-text message; the map notes the pattern differs between connector code and JVM wrapper output, so this is a generic FQCN-ending-in-Exception/Error match, not a confirmed grammar

add.name: 'arcsight.connector.log.event_filter'
add.value: __e['message'] !== undefined ? (__e['message'].indexOf('Events Filtering Disabled Due to Syntax Error') > -1 ? 'disabled_syntax_error' : (__e['message'].indexOf('Filtering Enabled=true') > -1 ? 'enabled' : (__e['message'].indexOf('Filtering Enabled=false') > -1 ? 'disabled' : undefined))) : undefined

functions.description: fall back message to _raw for non-bracketed (wrapper-log) lines, combine the naive-local timestamp, trim the padded level, split the container prefix off the logger name, read the Source's file-path breadcrumb, and detect the three vendor-documented event-filter init strings -- all before rename
batch-rename status:mapped fields that need no further transform
tag event.dataset and drop the raw timestamp/level keys fully superseded by _time/log.level above
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
